messages:
noah: Observed SA-EAST GPU warm pool failing to fill since 05:43 UTC. Nodes stuck in init, jobs queuing.
tanya: grabbing init logs now, seeing `KMS:AccessDenied` and `tls handshake failed` followed by `connection reset`.
li: I pushed a NATGW scale-down and new egress default-deny template during the morning cleanup (was trying to cut idle NAT costs). Could be related.
ops-bot: policy applied: egress-default-deny-2026-09 by li at 2026-09-14T05:35:02Z.
noah: tcpdump from a failing init container shows SYN then RST to kms.sa-east-1.amazonaws.com IP ranges. Also seeing `NoRouteToHost` for audit-exporter endpoints.
tanya: quick mitigation suggestion: add ephemeral SG/NAT allowlist for KMS+STS+audit exporters for sa-east with TTL=20m while we investigate.
li: Applying ephemeral allowlist now. Prefer not to revert the whole template since it caught several unwanted flows.
ops-bot: ephemeral rule applied: sg-ephemeral-allow-kms-sa with expiry 20m.
noah: after patch I see successful decrypts in init logs:
```
2026-09-14T05:41:11Z init: sts:AssumeRole -> 200 OK
2026-09-14T05:41:12Z init: KMS Decrypt -> 200 OK
2026-09-14T05:41:38Z join: node registered to pool-gpu-sa1a
```

li: Good. Root cause appears twofold: 1) NATGW scale-down reduced SNAT capacity so some flows timed out and hit firewall deny paths; 2) egress-default-deny template omitted VPC endpoint/privatelink entries for bootstrap roles and audit exporters.
tanya: CloudTrail shows several `AssumeRole` failures with `AccessDenied` during the window, matching init errors.
audit-bot: Flagged SEC-2026-612: compliance-sensitive (audit exporters and KMS egress impacted). Recommend Privatelink/VPC endpoints and a hardened allowlist template.
finance: Cost note: spillover to eu-west/warm pools estimated +$1.9k/hr while degraded. Tagging finance for chargeback.
li: Follow-ups I'm adding: 1) revert NATGW scale-down policy for sa-east until we have autoscaling knobs for SNAT capacity 2) add VPC Privatelink request for KMS+STS+audit-exporter in sa-east-1 3) update egress template to include mandatory endpoint/privatelink exceptions and a CI lint that validates them 4) add a canary step in fw rollout pipeline that does STS AssumeRole + KMS decrypt + curl to audit exporter.
tanya: I'll create INC-2026-777 and attach tcpdumps, CloudTrail, init logs, and the ephemeral rule audit. Adding playbook snippet here:
```
- check nodes: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep NotReady`
- collect init logs: `kubectl -n infra logs <init-pod> -c init`
- grep for sts/kms errors: `grep -E "AssumeRole|AccessDenied|KMS|decrypt" init.log`
- tcpdump: `tcpdump -i eth0 host kms.sa-east-1.amazonaws.com or host audit-exporter.example.internal`
- mitigation: add ephemeral SG/NAT allow, or revert egress template
- monitor: `prometheus:autoscaler.node_join_rate` and `grafana:gpu-warmup`
```

li: I'll update the fw PR template and open the Privatelink ticket. Also adding an automated SNAT capacity check to infra autoscaler.
noah: thanks all. Closing thread when INC-2026-777 has the RCA linked and follow-ups are tracked. :white_check_mark:
